content.text: Initial assumption is that the inputs contain all necessary data to generate the caption. Examining the inputs, I need to identify the key elements to include in the caption. The focus is on creating a concise and informative caption that avoids any figure or caption prefixes, as well as markdown formatting.

The provided caption clearly states the key elements: a deterministic calculation with five observations and no stochastic elements. Considering example captions, the focus is on concisely conveying this information. The objective is to distill this description into a clear, informative academic caption, excluding any unnecessary prefixes or formatting.
Recorded mean squared error across three intercept corrections. Values correspond to one deterministic calculation evaluated on the same
five observations used to determine the correction (b = 3), with no stochastic repetitions, optimizer, external dataset, held
-out evaluation, uncertainty intervals, or interpolated values.
